specval.description: The version of the spec format. It is always 1.

id.description: The ID of the ticket, for example ORD-142. Use letters, digits, '.', '_', and '-'. Name the spec file <id>.yaml.

kind.description: The kind of change: feature, bugfix, or chore.

status.description: draft until the change is implemented. Set done in the change that implements the spec. Then specval checks only the format of the spec.

title.description: The title of the change, on one line.

summary.description: A short paragraph that tells the problem and the new behavior.

acceptance.description: The acceptance criteria. Give one or more, and make each one possible to test.

id.description: AC and a number, for example AC1.

text.description: A statement that you can test: Given ..., when ..., then ....

new.description: The services that this change adds.

name.description: A PascalCase name that ends with the suffix of its layer, for example RefundEngine.

layer.description: The layer of the service, for example engine.

purpose.description: One sentence that tells what the service does.

changed.description: The registered services whose behavior changes.

calls.description: Each call from one service to another that this change adds or changes.

from.description: The service that makes the call.

to.description: The service that gets the call.

op.description: The name of the operation, in PascalCase, for example CalculateRefund.

covers.description: The acceptance criteria that this call helps to satisfy, for example [AC1].

out_of_scope.description: The things that this change does not do, but that a reader could expect it to do.
